metadata.title: Pembrolizumab, Carboplatin AUC 5 and weekly Paclitaxel 80 mg/m² followed by Doxorubicin and Cyclophosphamide (AC 60/600) Therapy
metadata.indication: Pembrolizumab in combination with chemotherapy as neoadjuvant treatment, then continued as monotherapy as adjuvant treatment after surgery, for adults with locally advanced or early-stage triple-negative breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.

validation.source_method: Official web-extracted NCCP PDF text and page/table review; not an independent human clinical sign-off.

metadata.source_title_exact: Pembrolizumab, CARBOplatin AUC 5 and weekly PACLitaxel 80 mg/m² followed by DOXOrubicin and cycloPHOSphamide (AC 60/600) Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

cautions: Systemic corticosteroid dose >10 mg prednisolone-equivalent daily, excluding inhaled or topical therapy
Active clinically significant infection requiring therapy
History of hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to pembrolizumab, carboplatin, paclitaxel, doxorubicin, cyclophosphamide, or excipients
Disease progression while receiving platinum-based chemotherapy

administration.alternative_route_note: May be administered as IV bolus over 5-10 minutes.

notes: Measured GFR is preferred whenever feasible.
Where overweight or obesity may overestimate GFR, adjusted ideal body weight in Cockcroft-Gault may be considered.
If isotope GFR is used, dose may remain unchanged while serum creatinine is <=110% of the value at isotope measurement.
If serum creatinine rises, consider remeasurement or re-estimation of GFR.

baseline: Isotope GFR preferred or GFR/CrCl estimation
MUGA or ECHO where age >65 years or clinically indicated before doxorubicin
regular: FBC, renal and liver profile weekly during cycles 1-4
FBC, renal and liver profile before each cycle thereafter
MUGA or ECHO if clinically indicated
Peripheral neuropathy assessment before each paclitaxel treatment

pembrolizumab_irae_rules.general_recovery_requirement: Withhold until adverse reaction recovers to grade 0-1 unless otherwise specified.
pembrolizumab_irae_rules.permanent_discontinuation_12_week_rule: Permanently discontinue if treatment-related toxicity does not recover to grade 0-1 within 12 weeks after the last dose, or if corticosteroid cannot be reduced to <=10 mg prednisone-equivalent daily within 12 weeks.

day_8_and_thereafter.note: May be omitted in the absence of hypersensitivity according to consultant guidance.

other: Consider analgesia for paclitaxel-associated myalgia or arthralgia.
Encourage oral fluid intake of 2-3 litres on day 1 to reduce cyclophosphamide-associated haemorrhagic cystitis risk.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk changes by treatment phase; use the phase/day-specific profile rather than one regimen-wide script.

global_safety_rules.action: Do not administer adjuvant pembrolizumab if disease progression precluded definitive surgery or unacceptable pembrolizumab-related toxicity occurred during neoadjuvant treatment.
Review cumulative anthracycline dose, previous anthracyclines or anthracenediones, mediastinal/pericardial radiotherapy, pre-existing heart disease, concomitant cardiotoxic drugs, and age.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms that limit self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Diarrhoea: 4-6 stools/day above baseline or moderate ostomy-output increase; limits instrumental ADL. Colitis: abdominal pain or mucus/blood in stool.

options.label: Grade 2

options.label: Grade 3
